_about: Operator bundles (agent 381, round 18): one installable bundle per (route, role). ops/bundle.py builds a bundle from the route's committed tools and config templates at a git revision; ops/bridgectl.py installs, checks, starts, upgrades, rolls back and health-checks it on the host. Placeholders: {inst} = <route>-<role>, {release} = /opt/bloch-bridge/{inst}/current, {etc} = /etc/bloch-bridge/{inst}, {state} = /var/lib/bloch-bridge/{inst}, {run} = /run/bloch-bridge-{inst} (staged secrets, tmpfs, removed when the unit stops), {cast} = /opt/foundry/bin/cast, {py} = /usr/bin/python3 -E -s. docs/OPERATOR-PACKAGES.md explains every field.

facts._about: Fixed public facts: the only literal values (besides TBD-owner, layout paths and decided parameters) a rendered config may hold. Each one names its source.

values.https://l2rpc.blochl1.com: public L2 send gateway, decided for l2_tx_rpc (docs/BUSDC-MAINNET-V2.md:348)
values.mainnet-v2: L2 finality pins of the launch build (tools/signatario-stable/l2_finality.py)
values.rebuild: l2_source decided for mainnet signers (docs/BRIDGE-V3-OPERATOR-RUNBOOK.md section 3)
values.stable: guardian kind of the stablecoin bridges (tools/guardiao/guardiao.py)
values.busdc-mainnet: bridge name of the Ethereum bUSDC route in the guardian and reserves configs
values.python3: interpreter argv[0] in eth_half_* commands (the unit runs with ProtectSystem=strict; /usr/bin/python3 is the only python3 on PATH)

hardening._about: Applied to every daemon and timer unit. A role may only ADD lines (role.units[].extra); the builder refuses a unit spec that names one of these keys. Reasons: docs/OPERATOR-PACKAGES.md section 4.
